ad_library.summary: Ecolt Energy is running 2 live Telugu ads on Meta - both sharing one creative (Library ID 1405421181747986, started 13 October 2026) - selling a 3KW rooftop system at ₹1,90,000 with a ₹33,000 discount plus the ₹78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy, and every click lands in a Facebook lead form. funnel.meaning: Every click is captured inside Facebook. The polished ecoltenergy.com - savings calculator, project map, WhatsApp chat - is invisible to the buyer the ad just paid for.

findings: 2 live Telugu ads - both sharing one creative (Library ID 1405421181747986, running since 13 October 2026) - and every click lands in a Facebook lead form. ecoltenergy.com receives none of the traffic.
The ad's WhatsApp number (+91 82475 37597) is different from the site's (+91 83411 13782) - two numbers, two funnels, one brand.

The live site's 'Real projects, real power' counters all read 0 - 0 MW capacity installed, 0 projects completed, 0 est. energy generated/yr, 0 CO₂ offset/yr - while the hero banner claims 2,000+ systems installed and 95% average bill reduction.
The site's live weather widget reads 'Right now in Virginia Beach: 16°C, clear skies' - hardcoded to a US city, on a Hyderabad solar company's homepage.

The build is genuinely good (interactive bill-vs-solar comparison, savings calculator, project map across AP & Telangana) - none of it is in the paid path, and there is no pixel or retargeting pool from this spend.
next_steps: Point the ads at an owned page
A landing page on ecoltenergy.com carrying the ad's exact offer - 3KW at ₹1,90,000, ₹33,000 off, subsidy eligibility - so the spend builds one measurable funnel instead of a Facebook form.
Fix the zero counters and the weather widget
0 MW installed and 0 projects next to a '2,000+ systems' claim, plus a Virginia Beach widget, are the first things a paid visitor checks.
The ad says +91 82475 37597, the site says +91 83411 13782. One number, everywhere, so the paid click and the site agree.
Two ads on one creative with no pixel means no audience to bring back and no way to see who dropped off after the click.
